n = int(input())
m = int(input())
mod = int(input())

# Initialize combinatorial table c
c = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
c[0][0] = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    c[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod

# Initialize factorial arrays f and g
f = [0] * (n + 1)
g = [0] * (n + 1)
f[0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        k = i - j - 1
        f[i] = (f[i] + f[j] * f[k] * (i + 1) * c[i - 1][j]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + g[j] * f[k] * (i + 1) * c[i - 1][j]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * g[k] * (i + 1) * c[i - 1][j]) % mod
        g[i] = (g[i] + f[j] * f[k] * c[i - 1][j] * (((j * (j + 1)) // 2) + ((k * (k + 1)) // 2))) % mod

# Initialize DP array
dp = [[[0, 0] for _ in range(n + 1)] for _ in range(n + 1)]
dp[0][0][1] = 1

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        dp[i + 1][j][1] = (dp[i + 1][j][1] + dp[i][j][0] + dp[i][j][1]) % mod
        for k in range(1, n - i + 1):
            dp[i + k][j + k][0] = (dp[i + k][j + k][0] + dp[i][j][1] * f[k] * c[j + k][j]) % mod

ans = 0
for j in range(n):
    for i in range(j):
        rem = m - (j - i + 1)
        if rem < 0:
            continue
        for k in range(rem + 1):
            ans = (ans + g[j - i + 1] * dp[i - 1][k][1] * dp[n - j][rem - k][1] * c[m][rem] * c[rem][k]) % mod

print(ans)
